name: Nisolo
why: Leather shoes, boots and sandals from Nashville, made by partner workshops in Mexico, Brazil and Europe and sold online.
origin: Founded in Nashville in about 2011, by press accounts; the brand does not say.

craft_evidence.owned: NONE: Trujillo, Peru factory (Creatra) closed by Jan 2025 per Eco-Stylist 25 Sep 2025; nisolo.com FAQ says it manufactures in Mexico, Brazil and parts of Europe via certified manufacturers; About says partner tanneries and factories
craft_evidence.makers: NONE (product page Leo Penny Loafer names none; About names none)
craft_evidence.madein: NC: country stated in FAQ only; one product page sampled (Leo Penny) states none
craft_evidence.heritage: vague on own site (no founding city/year); press dates it Nashville 2011
craft_evidence.process: partial: LWG page describes tannery steps (drum tumbling, toggle drying, hand-sprayed colour, hide traceability code); no shoemaking process documented
craft_evidence.reasoning: Own FAQ states manufacture in Mexico, Brazil and parts of Europe via certified manufacturers; About names partner tanneries and factories but none by name, and the brand owns none (Peru factory closed 2025, Eco-Stylist). LWG tannery process is described but unnamed. Stated countries and little else.

ownership.owner: Bought out of foreclosure in February 2025; nisolo.com names Project Bound Inc. as the buyer, and press names IRL Ventures. CEO Taryn Jones Laeben.
